title: America's Top Dog Has a 4.5-Year Life Expectancy
hook: The top-ranked dog has a 4.5-year population life expectancy.
closing: Popularity cannot replace a hard look at a breed's health and care needs.
question: What matters when choosing a dog?

segments.say: The French Bulldog ranks number 1. It displaced every other breed in the popularity list.
French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000%. Demand exploded rather than simply edging upward.
French Bulldog life expectancy was 4.5 years. That population estimate exposes the health cost popularity can hide.
